content.short: Brazilian digital bank for consumers and MEIs.
content.description: Neon is a Brazilian digital bank serving consumers and individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs) who want simple, low-fee banking through their phones. Its app offers free digital accounts, debit and credit cards, Pix instant payments, savings and investment products, personal and payroll-backed loans, and dedicated features for self-employed workers such as invoicing and business accounts. Neon targets working-class and underbanked Brazilians who have historically paid high fees at traditional banks, focusing on financial inclusion and credit access. By combining everyday accounts, cards, Pix, and credit with tools tailored to MEIs, Neon has grown into one of Brazil's notable challenger banks, competing with incumbents and other digital players for the country's large base of mobile-first customers.
